about: Demo autopilot script, read by backend/app/autopilot.py. A labelled simulation of the coordinator's workflow with the demo residents, not what happened on 23 July 2026. Timed by the forecast: a zone's order is approved `after_minutes` after the zone first enters the predicted spread (the first replay moment backend/app/impact.py gives it a time to impact), or `order_after_minutes` when no order names it; each outcome lands `after_minutes` after its resident's zone's order. Residents of a zone the forecast never reaches are not called. Residents are named by their position in the registry (1 is the first), because the deployed registry has other ids; positions it does not have are skipped. `mobility` and `observation` are keys of the "demo" section in backend/app/locales. `zone_of` names the zone by one of its residents. `calls` names, per status, the transcripts of data/demo_calls.json the dashboard shows as each outcome lands: the n-th outcome of a status takes the n-th, cycling.
